translation_notes: Context shim sls_context.py: POp, PANode (slsparser/pathls.py), Op, SANode, _extract_parameter_values (slsparser/shapels.py), verbatim from MaximeJakubowski/sls_project@58f7d7840f; the package is not installed. The shim replaces `from slsparser.pathls import PANode, POp` in both files.

The stratum's read: `if (shapename, RDF.type, RDFS.Class) in graph:` -> `if m{ {shapename} a rdfs:Class }(graph):` (call suffix: graph is a parameter, and the function has no other m{ }). `a` is the Turtle keyword for rdf:type; the other `RDF.type` / `RDFS.subClassOf` in the PANode trees are values, not reads, and become `rdf:type` / `rdfs:subClassOf`.

The five `_extract_parameter_values(graph, shapename, SH.x)` calls stay: the helper is a project function (`list(graph.objects(...))`) taking the predicate as an argument; only its argument SH.x -> sh:x changes. Not rewritten in the region because it lives outside it.

Driver: ten calls on a fixture of shapes (every kind of target + implicit class; class-only and node-only single-child shortcuts; no target -> Op.BOT) with neighbours that must not match (owl:Class, rdfs:subClassOf rdfs:Class, rdfs:Class only as an object, a different node being an rdfs:Class, an absent IRI) and a blank-node shape. SANode.__eq__ compares op, children, constraintComponent. Mutants killed: `a ?c`, free subject, free predicate, `not`.
